problem: The phrase "using λ or 2λw is a sign/slope slip" is inaccurate. Using λ or 2λw instead of λw is a factor/magnitude error, not a sign or slope error; this wording may confuse students about the common mistake.
fix: Rewrite as "using λ or 2λw instead of λw is a factor error; always differentiate (λ/2)w² carefully."

where: Section 2, Dropout, initial bullets and test-time rule
problem: The bullet "At test time, every unit is active" is true but incomplete for standard dropout, where activations are also scaled by p. The text later specifies inverted dropout needs no scaling, but the earlier statement may confuse a student who uses the initial standard-dropout description.
fix: Clarify: "At test time, every unit is active; for standard dropout, multiply by p, but in the inverted dropout described next, no scaling is needed."
